decision: The owner renamed the Patron feature from Named Workspaces to Workspaces. Capability, pricing and boundaries are unchanged, internal identifiers keep their workspace names, and frozen release notes and earlier claim ledgers keep the wording they shipped with.

supportAnswers.before: Browsing essentials and ordinary tab groups are free. Blanc Patron is the optional subscription: US$30 per year or US$4 per month, plus applicable tax. It adds saved Named Workspaces. Creating a named workspace requires an active Patron subscription. If membership lapses, existing workspaces remain openable, switchable, and automatically updated. Renaming and removing existing workspaces continue to work if it lapses. Earlier one-time supporters keep their lifetime Patron access.
supportAnswers.after: Browsing essentials and ordinary tab groups are free. Blanc Patron is the optional subscription: US$30 per year or US$4 per month, plus applicable tax. It adds saved Workspaces. Creating a workspace requires an active Patron subscription. If membership lapses, existing workspaces remain openable, switchable, and automatically updated. Renaming and removing existing workspaces continue to work if it lapses. Earlier one-time supporters keep their lifetime Patron access.

supportAnswers.before: Blanc has no built-in AI assistant or page summarizer. Named Groups and Named Workspaces are user-directed; Blanc does not infer tasks or organize tabs by meaning. You can visit AI websites as you can other websites.
